children: Eagle Financial Services entered into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with John Marshall to combine in an all-stock transaction. Each Eagle share will convert into 2.00 shares of John Marshall, with cash in lieu of fractions; the parties intend the mergers to qualify as tax-free reorganizations. Bank of Clarke will merge into John Marshall Bank at the same time, with John Marshall Bank as the surviving bank. Boards will be split 50/50, with designated leadership roles and headquarters in Reston and Berryville, Virginia.
